suggestions.title: Manually inspect high-risk patch proposals
suggestions.notes: Do not apply high-risk patches through the comfort of optimism. Optimism has broken enough builds.

suggestions.title: Review large files for possible splitting
suggestions.evidence: Largest indexed file: data/project_index.json with 4465 lines.
suggestions.notes: Large files are harder for local models to patch safely and easier for humans to ruin. Humanity adapts by making smaller messes.

suggestions.title: Review proposed patches waiting for approval
suggestions.notes: Review the diff before applying. Future-you deserves fewer surprises, allegedly.
